ai.title: AI providers
ai.lead: Use your own API key for auto captions and transcript tools. Transcription works with OpenAI or Google Gemini. All three providers can clean up and translate a transcript and suggest chapters, a title or a summary for it; Anthropic Claude cannot transcribe (the Claude API does not accept sound).

ai.empty: No provider yet. Add one to transcribe recordings and work on captions.

updates.title: Updates
updates.hint: Flown looks for a new version on GitHub every few hours, downloads it in the background and installs it when you close Flown. The same check refreshes the list of suggested AI models.
